class.name: OcgGpMat
class.brief_description: Describes a three column, three row matrix. This sort of object is used in various vectorial or matrix computations.
class.description: ! Describes a three column, three row matrix. ! This sort of object is used in various vectorial or matrix computations.

method.name: default
method.description: creates a matrix with null coefficients.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Creates a matrix. theCol1, theCol2, theCol3 are the 3 columns of the matrix.

method.name: SetCol
method.description: Assigns the three coordinates of theValue to the column of index theCol of this matrix. Raises OutOfRange if theCol < 1 or theCol > 3.

method.name: SetCols
method.description: Assigns the number triples theCol1, theCol2, theCol3 to the three columns of this matrix.

method.name: SetCross
method.description: Modifies the matrix M so that applying it to any number triple (X, Y, Z) produces the same result as the cross product of theRef and the number triple (X, Y, Z): i.e.: M * {X,Y,Z}t = theRef.Cross({X, Y ,Z}) this matrix is anti symmetric. To apply this matrix to the triplet {XYZ} is the same as to do the cross product between the triplet theRef and the triplet {XYZ}. Note: this matrix is anti-symmetric.

method.name: SetDiagonal
method.description: Modifies the main diagonal of the matrix. The other coefficients of the matrix are not modified.

method.name: SetDot
method.description: Modifies this matrix so that applying it to any number triple (X, Y, Z) produces the same result as the scalar product of theRef and the number triple (X, Y, Z): this * (X,Y,Z) = theRef.(X,Y,Z) Note: this matrix is symmetric.

method.name: SetIdentity
method.description: Modifies this matrix so that it represents the Identity matrix.

method.name: SetRotation
method.description: Modifies this matrix so that it represents a rotation. theAng is the angular value in radians and the XYZ axis gives the direction of the rotation. Raises ConstructionError if XYZ.Modulus() <= Resolution()

method.name: SetRow
method.description: Assigns the three coordinates of Value to the row of index theRow of this matrix. Raises OutOfRange if theRow < 1 or theRow > 3.

method.name: SetRows
method.description: Assigns the number triples theRow1, theRow2, theRow3 to the three rows of this matrix.

method.name: SetScale
method.description: Modifies the matrix so that it represents a scaling transformation, where theS is the scale factor. :

method.name: SetValue
method.description: Assigns <theValue> to the coefficient of row theRow, column theCol of this matrix. Raises OutOfRange if theRow < 1 or theRow > 3 or theCol < 1 or theCol > 3

method.name: Column
method.description: Returns the column of theCol index. Raises OutOfRange if theCol < 1 or theCol > 3

method.name: Determinant
method.description: Computes the determinant of the matrix.

method.name: Diagonal
method.description: Returns the main diagonal of the matrix.

method.name: Row
method.description: returns the row of theRow index. Raises OutOfRange if theRow < 1 or theRow > 3

method.name: ChangeValue
method.description: Returns the coefficient of range (theRow, theCol) Raises OutOfRange if theRow < 1 or theRow > 3 or theCol < 1 or theCol > 3

method.name: Added
method.description: Computes the sum of this matrix and the matrix theOther for each coefficient of the matrix : <me>.Coef(i,j) + <theOther>.Coef(i,j)

method.name: Divided
method.description: Divides all the coefficients of the matrix by Scalar

method.name: Inverted
method.description: Inverses the matrix and raises if the matrix is singular. - Invert assigns the result to this matrix, while - Inverted creates a new one. Warning The Gauss LU decomposition is used to invert the matrix. Consequently, the matrix is considered as singular if the largest pivot found is less than or equal to gp::Resolution(). Exceptions Standard_ConstructionError if this matrix is singular, and therefore cannot be inverted.

method.name: Multiplied_1
method.description: Computes the product of two matrices <me> * <Other>

method.name: Multiply_1
method.description: Computes the product of two matrices <me> = <Other> * <me>.

method.name: Multiply_2
method.description: Multiplies all the coefficients of the matrix by Scalar

method.name: Powered
method.description: Computes <me> = <me> * <me> * .......* <me>, theN time. if theN = 0 <me> = Identity if theN < 0 <me> = <me>.Invert() *...........* <me>.Invert(). If theN < 0 an exception will be raised if the matrix is not inversible

method.name: Subtracted
method.description: cOmputes for each coefficient of the matrix : <me>.Coef(i,j) - <theOther>.Coef(i,j)

method.name: Transposed
method.description: Transposes the matrix. A(j, i) -> A (i, j)

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream
